title: Viking Armor and Weapons
description: This mod adds Viking Armor and Weapons to Minecraft.
body:
This mod adds Viking Armor and Weapons to Minecraft.

Features:

- Viking Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggins, Boots)
- Battle Hammer (Strong hammer with knockback)
- Battle Axe
- Throwing Axe (with a chance to break on impact, can be repaired)
